proof_origin.text: Lean proof of the Chow paragraph of Stacks Tag 02O5, using the existing affine-base projective ample-invertible theorem, explicit projective-space base change, pullback composition, and ampleness invariance. Verified against https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02O5 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PU. No parent theorem is used.

proof.text: The integral polynomial Proj twist O(1) is invertible by the proved source instance Proj.isInvertible_twist_homogeneousSubmodule. For any morphism, uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensorPullback with Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pullback; IsInvertible.pullback and IsInvertible.of_iso then preserve invertibility. Apply this twice to the integral-model projection and j to obtain the global witness hL.

Properness composes, so hj makes j followed by the projective-space structure morphism proper. Projective space is separated over its base. IsProper.of_comp therefore makes j proper; the closed-image criterion applied to j.isClosedMap.isClosed_range makes j a closed immersion. ProjectiveSpace.isClosedImmersion_liftBaseChange makes the induced morphism k=(j,pi) into projective space over Z a closed immersion.

For any closed immersion i:X->P^m_B with affine B, compose i with ProjectiveSpace.map B.toSpecGamma. This projective-space map is a closed immersion because it is the base change of the affine isomorphism B.toSpecGamma. Apply projective_closedImmersion_ample_invertible over the ring Gamma(B,top). ProjectiveSpace.map_toProjInt and nonempty_tensorPullbackComp identify its twice-pulled integral twist with the twice-pulled twist for i. Transport invertibility and ampleness using IsInvertible.of_iso and isAmple_iff_of_iso. This is the proved private helper projective_ample_affine.

For an affine open V of the base, use morphismRestrict f V and its cartesian square. ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_liftBaseChange identifies the induced immersion into P^m_V as a base change of i; Mathlib MorphismProperty.of_isPullback preserves its closed-immersion property. Apply the previous affine-base helper. ProjectiveSpace.liftBaseChange_toProjInt and successive nonempty_tensorPullbackComp isomorphisms identify that module with the restriction of i*O(1). Transport ampleness across this explicit isomorphism. Apply this proved private helper projective_ample_affine_open to j over S and to k over Z.

ProjectiveSpace.liftBaseChange_toProjInt identifies the composites of j and k to the integral projective model. Compose the two nonempty_tensorPullbackComp isomorphisms with eqToIso of that equality to obtain L isomorphic to k*O(1), without using the holed Chow twist-isomorphism component. Pull this isomorphism back along the inclusion of pi^{-1}(W); invertibility of L restricts by the first step. isAmple_iff_of_iso transfers the affine-open ampleness conclusion for k to the original displayed restriction of L. Pair the S and Z clauses with hL.

theorem chow_relative_ample_twist_properties (m : ℕ) (S Z X' : Scheme.{u})
    (g : Z ⟶ S) (π : X' ⟶ Z)
    (j : X' ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)); S))
    [IsProper g] [IsProper π] [IsImmersion j]
    (hj : π ≫ g = j ≫ (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)); S) ↘ S)) :
      ∃ hL : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt
            (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1))) S)).obj
            (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)))
              (ULift.{u} ℤ)) 1))).IsInvertible,
        (∀ V : S.Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
          ∃ hV : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback ((π ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt
                (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1))) S)).obj
                (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)))
                  (ULift.{u} ℤ)) 1)))).IsInvertible,
            @Scheme.Modules.IsAmple ((π ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback ((π ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt
                    (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1))) S)).obj
                    (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)))
                      (ULift.{u} ℤ)) 1)))) hV) ∧
        (∀ W : Z.Opens, IsAffineOpen W →
          ∃ hW : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (π ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt
                (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1))) S)).obj
                (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)))
                  (ULift.{u} ℤ)) 1)))).IsInvertible,
            @Scheme.Modules.IsAmple (π ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (π ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt
                    (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1))) S)).obj
                    (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin (m + 1)))
                      (ULift.{u} ℤ)) 1)))) hW)
